website_text: PayFlow: cloud payroll software for banks and financial institutions. Automate payroll, compliance and reporting.
answers: Yes, we sell payroll software to banks and fintech companies.
Our best customers are mid-sized European banks with 500 to 1,000 staff. A poor fit was a tiny credit union with 20 people; they could not afford it.
The biggest problem for them is manual payroll that takes days and causes compliance errors.
The CFO signs off, with the Head of HR involved.
We never sell to government bodies.
They want payroll done in one day with no audit findings.
notes: Baseline case: everything is stated clearly. The poor-fit example should become an exclusion.
